diffs.diff: magnetic flux density (mT): datasheet reading gives 65.57 per count, the part's model has 74.07
diffs.evidence: The model follows the AH3503 series sheet it cites (4.5-6 V, ±90 mT), whose typical sensitivity is 13.5 mV/mT ('Extremely Sensitive' sheet lists 'Flat response to 23kHz' and S typ 13.5), i.e. 1/0.0135 = 74.07 mT/V; the second reading used the later AH3503/E-UA revision (3.5-6.5 V, ±80 mT) whose table reads 'Sensititvity                                S          VCC=5V' with typ 15.25 mV/mT (1/0.01525 = 65.57), a different datasheet revision whose range overlaps the model's, so the model is right for the product it describes (now noted in SKILL).
